saw_lines: Home gym buyers compare racks and benches side by side, then check stability and footprint before they commit to a purchase.
So sales are won on screen one, where a proof number and an offer tell buyers the product is worth it.
Your 12 ads with written copy carry 0 proof numbers, so collect one real figure, like orders shipped, and lead three new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: 0 of 12 ads with written copy carry a proof number, so new buyers have no reason to trust you over the next brand. Collect one real figure, like orders shipped, and open three new ads with it.

18 of your 30 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so buyers see a product grid and no reason to stop. Write three story ads that open on a problem your product solves, and run them beside the feed.
7 of your Shop now ads send buyers to the homepage, so they search again before they can add to cart. Point each of those ads to the product page for the item its copy names.
0 of 12 ads with written copy carry an offer, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer or a bundle in the opening line of your three ads.
